en:
Creates a Lesser Firestone which can be equipped in the off hand.  When equipped, enchants the main hand weapon with fire, granting each attack a chance to deal $17809s1 additional Fire damage.  In addition, equipping the Lesser Firestone increases the damage done by fire spells by $23480s1.

Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

en:
Allows a hunter to teach $ghis:her; tamed scorpion the Dig Trap ability. Dig Trap allows the pet to enter stealth mode but will be rendered unable to move. If the scorpion attacks from this position it will deal additional damage.

Pet Level 22+

Armadilha de Escavação permite que o ajudante entre em modo furtivo, mas ficará incapaz de se mover. Se o escorpião atacar dessa posição, causará dano adicional. Requer: Ajudante de Nível 22 ou superior.

en:

en:

en:

Each strike has a chance of poisoning the enemy which instantly inflicts 10-30 damage.

en:

Requires: 
Pet Level 13+

en:

en: Equip a fishing pole and find a body of water to fish.  Right-Click on the bob in the water when it splashes to catch your fish.  Higher skill increases your chance of fishing successfully in higher level areas.
curr_pt: Equipe uma vara de pesca e encontre um corpo de água para pescar. Clique com o botão direito na boia quando ela afundar para fisgar o peixe. Quanto maior a perícia, maior a chance de pescar com sucesso em áreas de nível mais alto.
